snippet.title: A Plague Tale: Requiem - Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
🐀 Get it now: https://store.focus-entmt.com/w/aplaguetalegames
✉️ Sign up as a Focus member now to get latest info and upcoming exclusive offers for A Plague Tale: Requiem and the whole Focus catalogue: https://store.focus-entmt.com/w/login
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/APlagueTale
Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/APlagueTale

A Plague Tale: Requiem is 'a must-play’ – Check out the international reception in a one-of-a-kind accolade trailer.

Following its launch last week, A Plague Tale: Requiem, the sequel to the critically acclaimed A Plague Tale: Innocence by Asobo Studio and Focus Entertainment, has already conquered the hearts of players and garnered critical praise. Lauded since its debut entry A Plague Tale: Innocence, the series’ impact reaches new heights with A Plague Tale: Requiem, becoming a staple in the genre with reviews heralding “a well-written, breathtaking, powerful adventure” as well as “one of the finest adventures around”. Discover it all in today’s Accolades Trailer.

Highly focused on narration, A Plague Tale: Requiem supports powerful emotions with brilliant technical expertise, in-depth historical research and an immense attention to the depiction of human traits. Altogether, the critics noted the game’s "incredible acting, storytelling, and characters" and praised its "awesome story, fantastic graphics".

Focus Entertainment and Asobo Studio are thrilled by such a vibrant and positive reception, and can’t wait to hear all the thoughts and feelings that players will share in the future, as they journey through darkness with Amicia and Hugo. A Plague Tale: Requiem is a heartrending tale that they won’t soon forget, as one critic put it, “a story that will live on in my mind for years”.

A Plague Tale: Requiem is available now on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, PC and in Cloud Version on Nintendo Switch.
